read_first: exact research project and consumed inputs before progression
exact security sector and evidence event before raising an alarm
exact market signal evidence before changing demand
write_order: validate authority and referenced world objects
emit semantic event and routed information
invariants: Trade shipments move conserved cargo and funded escrow; delivery or seizure cannot duplicate goods.
Research consumes registered inputs and creates evidence/claims, never arbitrary free techniques or biological assets.
Security alarms require a persisted observation/evidence event; barrier records do not create omniscient detection.
Mission demand changes only from persisted evidence and is never a static-only clock.
A recovered corpse or protected remains asset requires an established dead subject and successful recovery mission; retry cannot duplicate the same remains.
The information root is bounded routing/count metadata only; exact claims, deliveries, holder knowledge, and delivery participation live in deterministic shards.

A materially risky crossing of a protected route resolves deterministic sector detection; successful detection creates evidence, alarm, claim, and delivery while failed detection creates no knowledge.

Research success yields knowledge only. Deployment requires an existing registered candidate, time-separated prototype tests, validation, and explicit approval; approval grants neither mastery nor finished stock.
